name: GCP Vertex AI
subtitle: Which Model Garden models are available in which Vertex AI region, probed live via GET {region}-aiplatform.googleapis.com/v1/publishers/<publisher>/models/<model>. Managed API models (Gemini, PaLM, Claude) can be called directly; Self-deploy models (Llama, Mistral, Qwen, DeepSeek, etc.) must be deployed to your own endpoint and region availability reflects catalog presence, not GPU/TPU capacity.

source.label: Generative AI on Vertex AI locations (Google Cloud docs)

caps.full: Directly callable via the Vertex AI managed API (Model-as-a-Service)
